messages:
ana (AE): Heads up: Solano legal sent a follow-up. Their engineers want a drop-in POC that mimics VendX's API exactly for 4 weeks so they can run integration tests. Key asks: identical response envelope (they use `result.text` and `result.metadata`), streaming chunk semantics, 422 for prompt validation errors, HMAC header X-VX-SIG for signed payloads, and request-level idempotency via X-Idempotency-Key. Can solutions/ML/security review feasibility?

devin (solutions): Feasible via a compatibility proxy. We'll translate endpoints: POST /v2/respond -> POST /v1/completions, and adapt envelope fields. Need to confirm streaming framing (they send SSE with event:data chunks). We can proxy SSE from our streaming API but need to ensure chunk boundaries and stop-token behavior match.

priya (ml): Important: exact-text expectations are tough unless we force deterministic decoding (temp=0, top_k=1) and match tokenizer. VendX model uses an older byte-level tokenizer; outputs will drift. For POC we can: 1) run a seeded comparison suite (500 prompts) to quantify drift, 2) provide a deterministic mode for POC, and 3) offer a post-processing step in proxy to normalize minor whitespace/quote variants. I can run the seed suite if we get the sample corpus. ETA 4 days.

mike (security): On signing we can accept X-VX-SIG HMAC. We'll need their public secret to validate if they want incoming verification; otherwise we can translate our Authorization => X-VX-SIG in the shim. Data residency: they need EU processing only. Hosted EU region ok, but BYOK requires Dedicated/Private. Also they requested DPA + SCCs and proof of SOC2; legal should confirm.

jess (legal): We'll need their standard SSQ and DPA; Solano asked that we complete their vendor security questionnaire and also allowed a short exceptions list for POC. I can turn around the DPA + SCCs in ~3 business days. For BYOK/contracting, SOW for a 3-month POC required.

ana (AE): Pricing ask: they want to compare VendX flat-per-call price vs our token model. They proposed a blended model for the POC: either capped tokens with per-call reconciliation or a flat per-call credit. Can we offer a POC credit equivalence?

devin (solutions): Proposal: 8-week POC (they asked 4 but we recommend 8 to include integration + regressions) on Dedicated EU with a 40% discount on committed nodes for the POC period, plus a 250M-token prepaid credit to smooth billing disputes. Also include telemetry access in Console and log retention for 30d.

priya (ml): For token accounting parity: run token counts over their sample corpus with both tokenizers and produce a mapping table + per-prompt delta. If they want us to bill per-call, we recommend counting output tokens only for the first POC to reduce variance.

mike (security): One blocker: Solano's infra requires HSM-wrapped keys for signing. Our Dedicated can be configured with customer-managed KMS (BYOK) tied to HSM. That adds ~5 days operational lead. If timeline must be 4 weeks total, we need to start provisioning immediately.

devin (solutions): Technical checklist I'm taking on: - build SSE proxy that preserves event:data chunks - translate headers (Authorization <-> X-VX-SIG) and idempotency key passthrough - synthesize 422 error mapping for input validation (their schema is stricter) - ensure Retry-After semantics match VendX (they use 60s default on 429) ETA: initial shim in staging in 3 business days.

priya (ml): I'll need the sample prompt corpus and their seeded RNG details if available. Send to me via DM (no attachments in public thread).

ana (AE): I've uploaded vendx_samples.csv to the shared drive and emailed legal the SSQ.

jess (legal): Draft SOW template for 8-week POC with pricing/discount baked in. I'll cc procurement and send draft by EOD tomorrow. Need final word on BYOK or not to include operational tasks.

mike (security): Also adding: IDS/IPS review for the dedicated instance, and we need an IP allowlist for their test harness. Please provide a CIDR block.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy: staging/vendx-compat-proxy started by devin  build be9c3  logs: https://deploys.internal/be9c3

devin (solutions): Putting the repo link in the DM. I'll post the staging endpoint once the canary is healthy and attach quick curl examples mapping VendX -> Redwood.

ana (AE): Thanks team 44d. I'll coordinate with Solano PM to get the CIDR, RNG details, and the exact error examples they assert. We'll aim for an internal go/no-go review at the 7-day parity snapshot.

priya (ml): Added: if we can get VendX's sample of 100 streaming responses, I can run chunk-boundary tests to ensure no reassembly differences.

mike (security): Noted. Blocking items: BYOK confirmation, CIDR block, and signed SSQ completion.

ana (AE): Keeping this thread as the single source of truth. Drop smaller asks here and I'll triage with Solano.
